description: This file defines the RouteMatchInterface interface for routing result classes in Drupal, specifying methods for retrieving route information and parameters.

classes.name: RouteMatchInterface
classes.description: Interface for classes representing the result of routing, providing methods to access route name, route object, and parameters.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name or NULL if no route is matched.

methods.name: getRouteObject
methods.description: Returns the route object or NULL if no route is matched.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Returns the processed value of a named route parameter.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the bag of all processed route parameters.

methods.name: getRawParameter
methods.description: Returns the raw value of a named route parameter.

methods.name: getRawParameters
methods.description: Returns the bag of all raw route parameters.
